titleEn: Check If String Is a Prefix of Array
title: 检查字符串是否为数组前缀
summary: 判断字符串 s 是否恰等于 words 前若干个完整单词按顺序连接。
insight: 依次追加单词；连接长度达到或超过 s 时立即比较，只有恰好相等才成立，不能在单词中间截断。

solutions.title: 逐词增量拼接
solutions.idea: 在每个单词边界检查是否恰好得到 s。
steps: 长度>=s.length 时返回 builder.toString()==s；遍历完仍不足返回 false

code.java: class Solution { public boolean isPrefixString(String s,String[] words){StringBuilder builder=new StringBuilder();for(String word:words){builder.append(word);if(builder.length()>=s.length())return builder.toString().equals(s);}return false;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun isPrefixString(s:String,words:Array<String>):Boolean{val builder=StringBuilder();for(word in words){builder.append(word);if(builder.length>=s.length)return builder.toString()==s};return false} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: bool isPrefixString(string s,vector<string>& words){string value;for(string& word:words){value+=word;if(value.size()>=s.size())return value==s;}return false;} };
